Accessibility issue: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds (2 occurrences)

findings.problemShort: elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
findings.solutionShort: ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets wcag 2 aa minimum contrast ratio thresholds
findings.solutionLong:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 2.24 (foreground color: #ffffff, background color: #1fb8ff, font size: 12.0pt (16px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1

issue.title: Accessibility issue: Links must be distinguishable without relying on color on /how-does-it-work

findings.problemShort: links must be distinguishable without relying on color
findings.solutionShort: ensure links are distinguished from surrounding text in a way that does not rely on color
findings.solutionLong:
Fix any of the following:
  The link has insufficient color contrast of 1.16:1 with the surrounding text. (Minimum contrast is 3:1, link text: #1fb8ff, surrounding text: #a0a0a0)
  The link has no styling (such as underline) to distinguish it from the surrounding text
